title: Make a folder inside a given folder in the Files app

setup.why: A fresh folder for this run in Download holding two empty folders and a file, so the agent has to pick the right one to go into.
Open the system file manager (DocumentsUI) on the run's folder.

instruction: In the Files app, inside the folder Download/computer-bench-{{nonce}}/{{s.parent}}, create a new folder named "{{s.child}} {{nonce}}".

checks.why: Lists {{s.parent}}, the folder in it and the run's folder: exactly the asked folder in {{s.parent}}, nothing in {{s.other}}, and the run's folder unchanged (its three entries, in a fixed order, and nothing else). Setup left {{s.parent}} empty, so an agent that does nothing fails, and so does one that made it in the wrong folder.
argv: d=/sdcard/Download/computer-bench-{{nonce}}; ls -1 "$d/{{s.parent}}"; [ -d "$d/{{s.parent}}/{{s.child}} {{nonce}}" ] && echo is-dir; echo ---; ls -1 "$d/{{s.other}}"; echo ---; for n in '{{s.parent}}' '{{s.other}}' 'notes-{{nonce}}.txt'; do [ -e "$d/$n" ] && echo "$n"; done; ls -1 $d | grep -c .

teardown.why: Delete the run's folder and everything in it.

oracle.why: Wait for the folder's listing: on a fresh phone it shows a moment after am start -W returns.
The overflow menu and the name dialog are the frontmost windows, so these acts name no target.
